what: Work list rows are collapsed to 230px, showing only the top of the photo, then on hover they expand to full height (the whole 16:9 photo) over .4s power3.inOut, pushing the rows below down, and collapse on leave with the same curve. Use it to hide a photo preview inside a one-line list.
note: Touch devices (hover false) stay expanded. The original applies it only in list view and releases the height when switching to grid view — if the caller removes the name from data-fx when changing views, the release frees the height.

from.where: works.html .fr-work__card — list view row 230px ↔ its own height
